title: Esports Awards 2026 nominees revealed: Jynxzi, Kai Cenat and top gaming names make the list
summary_full: The Esports Awards 2026 have revealed nominees across nine categories, covering major games, streamers, personalities, creators, teams, partners and esports services. Names including Jynxzi, Faker, Kai Cenat and iShowSpeed feature among the nominees. Voting is already live, with fans able to support their picks until November 10, 2026. Here’s the complete lineup across every category announced for this year’s awards.
